title: Bilik Kedua Dari Tangga
subject: sewa bilik di KL, jauh dari kampung
caption: Kuala Lumpur indie rock. Two clean electric guitars through a chorus pedal, no distortion anywhere until the final chorus, drums recorded in a live room with the cymbals open, melodic bass that moves against the vocal. Conversational Malay male lead, spoken-close, no belting, no melisma. 124 BPM, A major. Tired but not complaining. No EDM, no orchestral strings, no key change, no big hall reverb, no saxophone.
lyrics:
[Intro - clean guitars]

[Verse 1]
Bilik kedua dari tangga, tingkap menghadap dinding
Lampu kena pasang siang hari pun
Enam ratus sebulan, air api dikira lain
Aku dah kira tiga kali, sama je jawapannya

[Chorus]
Mak tanya bila balik
Aku cakap raya
Raya tu lapan bulan lagi
Dia kata okay, macam biasa

[Verse 2]
Housemate aku kerja shift malam, kami jarang jumpa
Dapur ada dua periuk, satu dia satu aku
Dia tinggalkan nasi lebih kadang-kadang
Aku tak pernah cakap terima kasih, dia tak pernah tanya

[Chorus - distortion enters]
Mak tanya bila balik
Aku cakap raya
Raya tu tujuh bulan lagi
Dia kata okay, macam biasa

[Outro - guitars ring out]
Dia kata okay
